intro: Write down worries before the visit, yours and your child’s. Bring this list.

groups.title: For the parent
questions: What is the diagnosis, in plain words?
What are the phases of treatment and how long is each?
Which fever or symptoms mean I call right away, and what number do I use at night?
Can my child go to school or see friends? What precautions?
Who can help us: child life, social work, costs?
How do I talk to my child’s brother or sister?

groups.title: Questions many children ask (your child can say, draw or point)
questions: Can I still play and see my friends?
Did I do something to make this happen?
Will my mom or dad stay with me?

call_card:
Ask the care team to fill this in before you leave.
Call right away if fever of: ____________
Other warning signs: ____________
Day number: ____________   Night/weekend number: ____________
child_note: A child life specialist can help explain things to your child with play and pictures. Ask if one is available.
